sql:
WITH redemptions AS (
  SELECT cr.id AS redemption_id, cr.order_id, cr.discount_amount, cr.currency_code, cr.redeemed_at, c.code
  FROM coupon_redemptions cr
  JOIN coupons c ON c.id = cr.coupon_id
  WHERE cr.redeemed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cr.redeemed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
discount_eur AS (
  SELECT r.code, r.order_id, r.discount_amount / er.rate AS discount_amount_eur
  FROM redemptions r
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR' AND er.quote_code = r.currency_code AND er.as_of = CAST(r.redeemed_at AS date)
),
code_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT code, order_id FROM redemptions
),
orders_eur AS (
  SELECT co.code, co.order_id, o.grand_total / er.rate AS grand_total_eur
  FROM code_orders co
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = co.order_id
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR' AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code AND er.as_of = CAST(o.placed_at AS date)
),
returns_eur AS (
  SELECT co.code, co.order_id, SUM(orr.refund_total / er.rate) AS order_refund_eur
  FROM code_orders co
  JOIN order_returns orr ON orr.order_id = co.order_id
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR' AND er.quote_code = orr.currency_code AND er.as_of = CAST(orr.refunded_at AS date)
  GROUP BY co.code, co.order_id
),
discount_agg AS (
  SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS times_redeemed, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_count, SUM(discount_amount_eur) AS discount_given_eur
  FROM discount_eur
  GROUP BY code
),
refund_agg AS (
  SELECT code, SUM(order_refund_eur) AS refund_amount_eur, COUNT(*) AS orders_with_return
  FROM returns_eur
  GROUP BY code
),
order_value_agg AS (
  SELECT code, AVG(grand_total_eur) AS avg_order_value_eur
  FROM orders_eur
  GROUP BY code
)
SELECT
  d.code,
  d.times_redeemed,
  d.orders_count,
  ROUND(d.discount_given_eur, 0) AS discount_given_eur,
  ROUND(COALESCE(r.refund_amount_eur, 0), 0) AS refund_amount_eur,
  ROUND(d.discount_given_eur + COALESCE(r.refund_amount_eur, 0), 0) AS net_cost_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(r.orders_with_return, 0) / NULLIF(d.orders_count, 0), 1) AS refund_rate_pct,
  ROUND(ov.avg_order_value_eur, 0) AS avg_order_value_eur
FROM discount_agg d
LEFT JOIN refund_agg r ON r.code = d.code
LEFT JOIN order_value_agg ov ON ov.code = d.code
ORDER BY net_cost_eur DESC, d.code ASC
LIMIT 20
note: Grouped by the coupon's literal code text across all tenants (not per-tenant), since the question asks about code patterns like "Welcome10" rather than one merchant's coupons; if two merchants happen to reuse the same code string, their redemptions are combined into one row. Rates for discount, refund and order value each use the exchange rate as of their own respective date, as specified.
